compressionRule: A-E research vocabulary is not frozen by default. Only cross-GameForm responsibilities or anti-collapse/evidence guards survive; mechanism theories and downstream challenge/embodiment detail are handed off or retained as derived views.

items.name: DeepActionSeparation
items.reason: Input/control/action/execution/outcome collapse repeatedly fails across direct, symbolic, remapped and delegated control.

items.name: SkillState
items.reason: scalar/state wording was reconstructed into non-scalar SkillProfile.

items.name: BodyLocusSeparation
items.reason: Biological body, input effector, control locus and Human experiential body targets remain non-identical.

items.name: GameActionAvailabilityGuard
items.reason: Capability, ecological affordance, perceived affordance, Game legality/admission and cue cannot be collapsed.

items.name: TaskRelevantConsistency
items.reason: Skill-relevant variability is defined relative to relevant variables, not exact repetition or global variance.

items.name: SymbolicActionPipeline
items.reason: Useful implementation/research view over GameActionContract but not a separate foundation.

items.name: InternalPredictiveModelControl
items.reason: Human sensorimotor mechanism; Game consumes consequences without selecting one universal theory.

items.name: OptimalFeedbackMinimumIntervention
items.reason: Motor-control mechanism family; its anti-collapse consequence survives as a variability guard.

items.name: EcologicalAffordanceTheory
items.reason: Actor-environment action possibility theory remains valuable but is not identical to formal Game action authority.

items.name: ConstraintsDynamicalCoordination
items.reason: Coordination mechanism family below the Game semantic/control interface.

items.name: MotorProgramSchema
items.reason: Scope-limited motor organization theory; fixed-open-loop universal was rejected.

items.name: SpeedAccuracyModel
items.reason: Narrow quantitative performance law, not general Game Skill foundation.

items.name: AgencyComparatorInference
items.reason: Subjective agency mechanism; objective control remains separate.

items.name: SharedAssistiveHierarchicalControl
items.reason: Useful architecture family represented through ControlMapping plus contribution attribution; not universal structure.

items.name: SkillAsConditionalCapabilityDraft
items.reason: Superseded by scoped non-scalar SkillProfile.

items.name: TaskRelevantVariabilityProfile
items.reason: Global low variability is not Skill; variable relevance must be stated.

items.name: AssistanceTimescaleSeparation
items.reason: Immediate performance/access, subjective agency, independent later capability and joint-system mastery are distinct evidence targets.

items.name: SkillProfile
items.reason: Survives motor, strategic, symbolic, assisted and synthetic cases as a scoped learned conditional capability profile.

items.name: MechanismPluralControlInterface
items.reason: Game can freeze semantic/control responsibilities without selecting one Human motor mechanism theory.

items.name: SkillAcquisitionAdaptationSeparation
items.reason: Adaptation/recalibration can contribute to but does not exhaust durable Skill acquisition/refinement.

items.name: AffordanceLegalitySeparation
items.reason: Ecological possibility, perceived possibility and formal Game legality/action availability remain distinct.

items.name: SkillScopeSpec
items.reason: Serious Skill claims need attribution/practice/control/evaluation/transformation scope, but this is an evidence contract rather than ontology object.

items.name: GameActionContract
items.reason: Cross-GameForm Game-local semantic action identity/admission/consequence responsibility.

items.name: ControlMapping
items.reason: Context/version/provenance-bound mapping between control expression and Game control/action semantics survives remap/accessibility cases.

items.name: ControlContributionTopology
items.reason: Needed only when attribution/authority/value-relevant control is distributed; sparse projection suffices.

items.name: EvaluationTargetSet
items.reason: Fixed/static target set failed open sandbox and was replaced by current/provenance-bound evaluation commitments.

items.name: TaskRelevantVariableSet
items.reason: Fixed-task name failed generality; reconstructed to SkillRelevantVariableSet with task-specific subtype.

items.name: PerformanceSample
items.reason: One provenance/configuration-bound observation is evidence about capability, never Skill by identity.

items.name: ProbeTransformation
items.reason: Transfer/remap/perturbation/retention claims require explicit changed and held-fixed dimensions across every tested GameForm.

items.name: TechniqueFamily
items.reason: Useful only where recurrent functional organization earns it; not necessary for chess/RTS/sandbox/synthetic Skill.

items.name: LearningEvidenceContract
items.reason: Claim timescale/scope must match retention/transfer/history evidence; immediate change alone is insufficient for durable learning claims.

items.name: EntryRequirementSet
items.reason: Scalar/set wording reconstructed to multidimensional EntryRequirementRegion and handed downstream to Challenge/Mastery.

items.name: SkillExpressionEnvelope
items.reason: Capability-expression relation is important downstream; GDF1 freezes only the anti-collapse law Capability != Expression.

items.name: SaturationBoundary
items.reason: Unattributed plateau/ceiling language was insufficient; downstream use requires SaturationAttribution.

items.name: ControlAccessProfile
items.reason: Useful accessibility/remap projection but narrower than the general action/control core.

items.name: ControllerSpecificSkillProfile
items.reason: Human/System/Joint profiles are attribution-specialized uses of SkillProfile, not separate core objects.

items.name: EvaluationCommitmentSet
items.reason: Skill relevance may be formal, participant-authored, social/community or research-defined and must carry currentness/provenance; no fixed-goal assumption.

items.name: SkillRelevantVariableSet
items.reason: Cross-GameForm bridge from current Game/evaluation/control relevance to the variables on which Skill claims are evidenced.

items.name: EntryRequirementRegion
items.reason: Relational entry/viability region belongs primarily to difficulty/challenge once SkillProfile is available.

items.name: SaturationAttribution
items.reason: Observed plateaus need attribution, but detailed ceiling/challenge analysis is downstream.

items.name: ConditionalEmbodiment
items.reason: Reconstructed into explicit structural action couplings plus separate Human experiential targets.

items.name: CapabilityExpressionSeparation
items.reason: Latent/learned capability may be hidden by mapping, automation, challenge, action resolution or evaluation saturation.

items.name: HumanSystemJointAttribution
items.reason: Joint performance cannot automatically be credited to Human-independent or System-independent capability.

items.name: ObservedPlateauCeilingGuard
items.reason: Observed plateau is not Skill ceiling without identifying the saturating boundary/mechanism.

items.name: EmbodimentSingleConstruct
items.reason: Rejected after ownership/agency/self-location/structural body/tool roles were dissociated.

items.name: AvatarRepresentationRole
items.reason: Avatar is primarily representation/reference; Game retains only explicit bindings to control/collision/vulnerability/identity where present.

items.name: AvatarCollisionVulnerabilitySeparation
items.reason: Visual avatar, control locus, collision/passability and vulnerability/consequence geometry are not identical.

items.name: SensorEffectorSeparation
items.reason: Information access and action/effect reach are independent control constraints.

items.name: ToolVehicleMediation
items.reason: Useful structural role for transformed reach/dynamics/sensing/collision without body-identity claim.

items.name: ControlLocus
items.reason: Crosses direct, remote, vehicle, RTS and symbolic control as the Game-local locus receiving authoritative participant/controller control.

items.name: ActionCouplingProfile
items.reason: Useful sparse projection for body/tool/sensing/dynamics relations, but all content unfolds into existing core mappings/loci/GameStructure relations.

items.name: ExperientialEmbodimentProfile
items.reason: One composite embodiment score is not a precise target; separated Human constructs should be measured directly.

items.name: BodySchemaPeripersonalSpace
items.reason: Plastic body/action-space representation mechanisms are external owner science consumed only when relevant.

items.name: BodyOwnershipSenseOfAgencySelfLocation
items.reason: Distinct Human experiential/cognitive targets; not Game authority or objective control.

items.name: CollisionBody
items.reason: Authoritative passability/collision role when needed; not universal Game core.

items.name: VulnerabilityBody
items.reason: Authoritative damage/exposure/consequence role when needed; separate from collision/avatar.

items.name: BiologicalBodyMorphology
items.reason: Biological/material source constraints; Game consumes relevant structural projections only.

items.name: StructuralExperientialEmbodimentSeparation
items.reason: Structural body/tool coupling and Human ownership/agency/self-location evidence cannot be collapsed.
